function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• On highways, speed limits range from 55–75 mph; on rural roads, 45–65 mph; on urban streets, 25–35 mph.
• “No Speed Limit” zones exist in some areas (e.g., certain parts of Dallas). | | **Seat Belt Use** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Child Safety Seats** | • Children under 4 years old must be in a rear‑seat child safety seat.
• Children 4–8 years old may use a booster seat if they cannot reach the belt properly. | | **Cell Phone Use** | • Handheld phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system). | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• For drivers under 21, any detectable BAC is illegal. | | **Texting While Driving** | • Texting or typing while driving is prohibited. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching from the right have priority.
• Pedestrians always have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Stop Sign** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus has its stop sign extended and lights flashing. | | **Lane Usage** | • Drivers must stay within their lane unless turning or changing lanes. | | **Headlights** | • Headlights must be used from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather. | | **Towing Regulations** | • Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and registration. | | **Parking** | • Parking in front of fire hydrants, driveways, or on sidewalks is prohibited. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and pass an annual inspection. | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability insurance coverage is required. | ### How to Find Specific Laws 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Offers guides and FAQs. 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific ordinances or recent changes. If you need more detailed information on a particular aspect of Texas traffic law, let me know!
